declarations.name: AuiStatCard

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Metric name; names the card (group) and, by default, the trend sparkline. Non-empty.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: A number (formatted with valueFormat or formatValue), preformatted text, or null ('No value').

inputs.name: previous
inputs.description: Previous value; the change is computed from it when value is a number (percent: (value - previous) / |previous|, not shown for 0; absolute: value - previous). Finite.

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: Explicit change (a ratio for 'percent', units for 'absolute'); wins over previous. Finite.

inputs.name: comparisonLabel
inputs.description: Caption after the change, for example 'vs last month' (shown only with a change).

inputs.name: trend
inputs.description: Trend values rendered as a Sparkline (null is a gap); an empty array shows none.

inputs.name: trendLabel
inputs.description: Sparkline accessible label. Default: the card label.

inputs.name: trendColor
inputs.description: Chart palette slot of the sparkline (1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8; SparklineColor from @absoluteui/components/sparkline).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format of the value (and of an absolute change).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value formatter; wins over valueFormat (also used for an absolute change).

inputs.name: href
inputs.description: Make the whole card a link (http(s) or relative URLs only; others throw). The URL can change with update(), but adding or removing href throws.

inputs.name: busy
inputs.description: Show 'Loading' instead of the value (no change) and set aria-busy.

inputs.name: sentiment
inputs.description: Whether an increase is favorable, unfavorable, or neither; decides the color and the spoken 'favorable'/'unfavorable'.

inputs.name: deltaFormat
inputs.description: Relative change (percent, max 1 fraction digit) or the difference in value units.

accessibility.pattern: Static content grouped with role=group and named by its visible label; with href, a single native link wrapping the whole card. The change is spelled out in visually hidden text; the visible signed amount is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.

limitations: The trend sparkline needs the Sparkline stylesheet (@absoluteui/components/sparkline/style.css) in addition to the Stat Card stylesheet.
A percent change from a previous value of 0 is not shown (division by zero); pass delta explicitly if needed.
The change is computed only when value is a number; with a preformatted string value pass delta.
href cannot be added or removed after create (recreate the card).
With formatValue and deltaFormat 'absolute', a positive change is prefixed with '+' and a negative one relies on formatValue to print the minus sign.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
